# For customization of tables
library(reactable) |> suppressPackageStartupMessages()
render <- function(df_obj) {
  return(
    reactable::reactable(
      df_obj,
      searchable = TRUE,
      striped = TRUE,
      compact = TRUE,
      defaultPageSize = 8,
      theme = reactable::reactableTheme(
        style = list(fontSize = "14px")
      ),
      columns = list(
        nb_weight = reactable::colDef(
          # name = "MPG",
          format = reactable::colFormat(digits = 3)
        )
      )
    )
  )
}
